description: One event, with its snapshot: the state of the resource after it happened. This is how to read an item version too old to fetch with get_item's version. Guarded values are left out of snapshots, as they are from item data. 1 request.

includeAttachments.description: Include the event's attachments (e.g. why an index build failed)

index.description: The index (id or pathName), for resource "index"

item.description: The item, for resource "item". A deleted item only by id

list.description: The list (id or pathName); needed for list, item and index

resource.description: Whose history: a list, an item (needs list and item), an index (needs list and index) or an identity

name: get_event
title: Get an event
